_comment: Version single-source registry. package.json is the source of truth; every file in 'files' is synced mechanically by scripts/bump-version.sh. No other file may state the plugin's version. audit.scan paths are scanned for semver literals; a literal inside a fenced block, blockquote, or inline code span is a citation and is not reported, and one in running prose must carry an inline <!-- praxis:allow-version-literal reason="..." --> marker on the preceding line. Path allowlists were retired by ADR.260725 — they exempted whole directories and so inverted default-deny.
